prompt.project_info: Create a bright airy Mediterranean fashion lifestyle portrait for travel visuals.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long light-brown soft waves, a soft playful confident smile, and relaxed posture. She wears a white cropped knit top with open crochet flared sleeves, a high-waisted blue tiered maxi skirt, black sunglasses on her head, a dark red shoulder tote, and holds a disposable coffee cup.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter body portrait with a slightly angled side-back perspective, subject right of center balanced by whitewashed architecture. She stands with torso turned back and looks over her shoulder toward camera. Show stucco walls, blue door/window frames, stone pavement, pink bougainvillea, and quiet Mediterranean street context.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural top-right daylight, defined shadows on wall and ground, bright crisp high-key exposure, vibrant blue and pink against clean white architecture, lighthearted leisurely summer mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Clean high-fashion travel photography, three-quarter body framing, standard perspective, detailed knit and flowing cotton texture, bright airy color grade, no typography.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bright airy Mediterranean fashion lifestyle portrait of an adult woman with long light-brown soft waves, standing on a whitewashed street with her torso turned back and looking over her shoulder toward the camera with a soft playful confident smile. She wears a white cropped knit top with open crochet flared sleeves, a high-waisted blue tiered maxi skirt, black sunglasses on her head, a dark red shoulder tote on her back, and holds a disposable coffee cup. Place her slightly right of center with stucco walls, blue door and window frames, stone pavement, and pink bougainvillea. Natural top-right daylight, defined wall and ground shadows, high-key crisp exposure, vibrant blues and pinks with clean whites, detailed fabric and surface textures, clean social-media-ready travel photography, no text.
